entries.title: Fixation of the Weil test function space and generating family
entries.summary: Fixed the Bombieri/Clay multiplicative group formulation; generated a compactly supported kernel with double vanishing moments using $D(D+1)$, and established Mellin–Fourier and correlation closure interfaces.

entries.title: Kernel range, topology, and normalization closure
entries.summary: Proved $D(D+1)C_c^\infty(0,\infty)=\mathcal C_{00}$, providing explicit inversion and LF continuity; aligned $Q_{B0}=W=\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_W$ on the double vanishing moment kernel.

entries.title: Compact support separation and dual-kernel architecture
entries.summary: Formalized the separation logic that under $\neg RH$, the full Weil kernel possesses a negative witness with finite logarithmic support; distinguished between the full kernel and the endpoint-zero simplified kernel, establishing specifications for finite-support spectral scanning.

entries.title: Finite-dimensional completeness and rational negative certificate protocol
entries.summary: Established a conditional completeness framework where negative directions will eventually become visible under a finite dictionary, along with a minimal verification format for rational negative quadratic form witnesses.

entries.title: The first real zeta 2D Weil interval matrix
entries.summary: Constructed a 2×2 rational interval matrix using the full explicit formula; with support below $\log2$, all prime terms resolve to zero, proving positive definiteness for the fixed 2D subspace.

entries.title: First prime activation and 5D stabilization
entries.summary: Isolated $n=2$ in the $\log2<R<\log3$ chamber; demonstrated that a prime-free witness can be negative, but positivity is restored after adding $n=2$.

entries.title: Multi-prime-power chamber compiler
entries.summary: Constructed a 9D Toeplitz matrix with activated indices $2,3,4,5,7$; explicitly computed prime powers separately.

entries.title: Automated chamber search and rigorous refinement
entries.summary: Selected a 13D chamber after searching 122 candidates, proving $Q(c)>10^{-5}c^TGc$; improved the leading error term of the Archimedean tail from $O(K^{-2})$ to $O(K^{-3})$.

entries.title: Adaptive continuation and one-in-a-billion margin
entries.summary: Constructed a 15D chamber and proved $Q(c)>10^{-9}c^TGc$; approached the $n=3$ boundary at lag-1.

entries.title: Prime boundary local modes and 7th-order soft start
entries.summary: Proved that the prime-3 activation amount for degree-7 correlation appears as $\mu_+^7/7!$, hence the boundary is $C^6$ rather than $C^7$; positivity is maintained both before and after the boundary.

entries.title: Kernel sensitivity and regularity duality
entries.summary: Derived the activation order $r=m+n+1$ from $\beta_m*\beta_n=\beta_{m+n+1}$, simultaneously controlling boundary regularity, Fourier decay, and tail bound order, proposing a mixed-order dictionary.

entries.title: Mixed-order dictionary and cross-cancellation modes
entries.summary: Constructed a 10D mixed dictionary with $m=1/3$, proving $1/2000<\lambda_{min}<1/1000$; discovered cross-regularity cancellations where self-channels are positive and cross-channels are negative.

entries.title: Cross-regularity near-zero spectral band and consistent quantization auditing
entries.summary: Identified the channel scaling $\alpha$ as a generalized spectral gauge parameter; corrected false negatives caused by M/G parameter identity mismatches; proved $10^{-8}<\lambda_{min}<5\times10^{-8}$.

entries.title: The first rigorous 2D low-spectral parameter tube
entries.summary: Fixed $h$ and proved the same near-zero positive spectral bounds for a minimal $(d,\sigma)$ rational rectangle. The original first-order Archimedean bound missed the out-of-support tail, which was later corrected by W-15 and retroactively re-proved.

entries.title: Interval–Taylor parameter tube expansion and tail correction
entries.summary: Added the $\operatorname{artanh}(e^{-R})$ out-of-support tail; expanded the 2D radius by 25,000 times using a four-corner convex combination plus a second-order remainder, still proving $10^{-8}<\lambda_{min}<5\times10^{-8}$.

entries.title: Three-parameter near-zero spectral tube
entries.summary: Incorporated the scale $h$, proving the same spectral bounds for a non-degenerate $(h,d,\sigma)$ 3D box using an eight-corner convex combination and a second-order remainder.

entries.title: Chamber-aware slicing and event thin layers
entries.summary: Traversed the spline central knot at $4d=\log2$, slicing the interval into a left chamber, an event thin layer, and a right chamber; the three closed intervals provided complete coverage and proved $\lambda_{min}>10^{-8}$.

entries.title: Unified certificate backend and historical state model
entries.summary: Unified types such as NUMERICAL_MATRIX, PARAMETER_REGION, CHAMBER_COVER, STRUCTURAL_IDENTITY, and PROTOCOL_ONLY, providing a single CLI and layered states.

entries.title: Reproducibility and adversarial certificate auditing
entries.summary: Created an erroneous certificate zoo; 16/16 expected errors were rejected, and a 14th-order Hilbert exact positive-definite / double false-negative example was used to illustrate that floating-point negative values cannot serve as negative certificates.

entries.title: Batch 01 integration and AI Autonomous Mathematics Research Platform Case 0001 release
entries.summary: Packaged the research graph, claims ledger, failures and corrections, certificate index, platform import data, and Batch 02 handoff for W-01 to W-20; replayed the W-19 backend and adversarial auditing.
